name: Akisaka Natsuki
source: Ryuuga's cute girlfriend and classmate. She's known Ryuuga and Mai since childhood and she and Ryuuga have been dating for awhile. She comes to greet him every morning and walk him to school and although they sometimes share a kiss together it's as far as their relationship has gone.
